title: Slope.
officialText:
A vent connector shall be installed without dips or sags and shall slope upward toward the vent or chimney at least
¼ inch per foot (21 mm/m).
Exception: Vent connectors attached to a mechanical draft system installed in accordance with the manufacturers’ instructions.
